description: This Java class, ContentPagesController, is a Spring MVC Controller responsible for handling content page CRUD operations within the admin area of a web application, specifically managing Content entities of type PAGE. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, viewing details, deleting, and saving content pages, as well as checking for unique content codes.

classes.name: ContentPagesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller for managing content pages in the admin interface, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and auxiliary functions.

methods.name: listContentPages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list content pages, sets up menu context, and returns the view for listing pages.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initiate creation of a new content page, initializing a Content object with descriptions for each store language.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Retrieves existing content page details by ID, validating ownership and content type, and prepares the model for editing.

methods.name: removeContent
methods.description: Processes POST requests to delete a content page by ID, with authorization and validation checks, returning JSON status.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of content entries filtered by type (PAGE or BOX) for the current store and language.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update content pages, validating input, setting relations, and persisting changes.

methods.name: checkContentCode
methods.description: Checks if a given content code is unique within the store, returning JSON status for frontend validation.
